name: 85250 · Scottsdale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85250 (Scottsdale) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85250 (Scottsdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
